exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Who do you spend most time studying/working with? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: What kinds of things do you study/work on with other people? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Are there times when you study/work better by yourself? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Is it important to like the people you study/work with? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a tourist attraction you enjoyed visiting. You should say: what this tourist attraction is when and why you visited it what you did there and explain why you enjoyed visiting this tourist attraction.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Different kinds of tourist attractions What are the most popular tourist attractions in your country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Different kinds of tourist attractions How do the types of tourist attractions that younger people like to visit compare with those that older people like to visit?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Different kinds of tourist attractions Do you agree that some tourist attractions (e.g. national museums/galleries) should be free to visit?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: The importance of international tourism Why is tourism important to a country?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: The importance of international tourism What are the benefits to individuals of visiting another country as tourists?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: The importance of international tourism How necessary is it for tourists to learn the language of the country they’re visiting?
